body: Thank you for this, but closing as I already added a similar test to the PR in the last spec update

Thanks @KvngMikey, this is nice work and the tests are thorough. I've pushed one commit on top rather than going back and forth on suggestions:

- The two spellings of the same legacy ID (`+//wAAAAAAAA` and `-__wAAAAAAAA`) were reported as a collision. `getKeysetIdInt` already treats them as the same keyset, so the dedupe now folds URL-safe base64 to standard, the same way it lowercases hex. There's a test for it.
- The legacy check now reuses `getDerivationKind` (wrapped in a try/catch) instead of repeating its rules, so the two can't drift apart. Your existing tests pass unchanged.
- The docs now say to pass keyset IDs from every mint the seed is used with. The derivation path doesn't include the mint, so cross-mint collisions are the more likely case.

Shout if anything looks off.

thanks @robwoodgate , these changes look good. 

great catch on dedupe of equivalent base64 spellings.

also, thanks for the clarification to collect IDs across all mints sharing the seed also makes the usage clearer and for adding the regression test.

Thanks @KvngMikey, this matches #848 well, and I checked the constants against the registry and CDK. I've pushed one commit on top:

- The named predicates are now type guards. Each one narrows to its own codes, eg `e is MintOperationError & { code: typeof MintErrorCode.PROOFS_PENDING | ... }`, so `e.code` is typed in the true branch. A plain `e is MintOperationError` would drop non-matching mint errors on the false branch, so the narrowing is deliberate, and there's a type-level test for it. `hasMintErrorCode` stays `boolean`, since it takes arbitrary codes.

This allows, for example:

```ts
if (isPendingError(e)) log(e.code); // previously e was still unknown here
```
- I removed the nutshell 8xxxx note from the issue. Nutshell moved to the registry codes in 0.21.0, so the PR is right to leave them out. I dropped the matching sentence from the docs as well.


please let me know if you are happy with these and I'll merge.
